title: Static High-Keel Long-Bill Compact Toucan
description: One newly authored whole stylised toucan-like bird in a fixed low standing display pose. This is not a parrot short deep hooked bill stretched or a pelican thin spear above a sagging pouch. New complete body/head, keel-bill volume, two folded wings, long broad low tail, two short legs and complete opposed-toe feet; a thick pale throat surface and small lateral eyes clarify the head.
